candidates.review: The archive context describes a Spring-based proof of concept and a Spring ClassPathXmlApplicationContext chain, then says this MethodFunction class can also be used “in Spring.” The working text changes this to an ownership claim (“belongs to Apache Commons JXPath, not Spring”) plus an extension-function role. The FQCN and surrounding article support distinguishing the library from Spring, but no original source URL or source statement was available here to establish that this is the intended correction or that the added role description precisely preserves the original claim. The article itself documents the edit in its “已落实的文本修订” bullet (working line 46), but that is an editorial rationale, not independent source evidence.
